question: Any amount becomes Rs. 660 in 5 years and Rs. 776 in 8 years by simple interest. Rate of interest per annum is equal to
solution:
**Given:**

An amount becomes Rs. 660 in 5 years 

An amount becomes Rs. 776 in 8 years

Formula Use:

Amount = Principal + Simple Interest

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × N × R)/100

Where,

P = Principal

N = Time Duration

R = Rate of Interest

Calculation:

We know,

Interest earned in three years = Rs. 776 - Rs. 660

⇒ Rs. 116

Interest earned in one year = Rs. 116over3

Interest earned in first 5 years = Rs. 116over3 × 5

⇒ Rs. 580over3

Amount = Principal + Simple Interest

⇒ 660 = P + 580over3

⇒ P = 660 - 580over3

⇒ P = Rs. 1400over3

Therefore,

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × N × R)/100

⇒ 580over3= 1400 × 5 × R over 100×3

⇒ R = 8(2)/(7)\%

**∴ The rate of interest per annum is 8(2)/(7)\%.**

8
